findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: place_order · Private data: request_to_owner · Public sink: list_niches, place_order, request_to_owner.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: place_order · Private data: request_to_owner · Public sink: list_niches, place_order, request_to_owner

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
